reason: This rule aligns with the contradiction pattern of negation, as it suggests that if Al-Nashar is arrested and located in Egypt, then it contradicts the status of being released.
refined_position: The contradiction arises from the simultaneous assertion of Al-Nashar's status as "arrested" while also claiming he is "released," which violates the logical consistency of his legal status in relation to his location in Egypt.
reflecting_rules: - 5. Q[Al-Nashar, Egypt](Al-Nashar.location = "Egypt" ∧ "Al-Nashar was arrested in Egypt on 14 July.".reason = "suspected terrorism" → violate(Al-Nashar.status, "released"))
